entities.name: PMID:27490042
observations: 2016 preclinical toxicity study of intracerebral lentiviral HSV-Tk.007 plus ganciclovir in healthy, immunocompetent rats.

entities.name: Normal-brain safety in rats
observations: After intracerebral lentiviral HSV-Tk.007 and 14 days of ganciclovir, transduced normal rat brain cells survived; no significant treatment-control difference in transduced-cell counts, behavior, inflammation, or apoptosis was reported in the abstract.
